edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria)

1:11.hebrew: וּמִצְרַיִם יָלַד אֶת־לודיים [לוּדִים] וְאֶת־עֲנָמִים וְאֶת־לְהָבִים וְאֶת־נַפְתֻּחִים׃
1:11.english: Mizraim fathered the Ludim, the Anamim, the Lehabim, and the Naphtuhim,
1:11.editorial_note: The English follows the qere Ludim, as in Genesis 10:13.

1:12.hebrew: וְאֶת־פַּתְרֻסִים וְאֶת־כַּסְלֻחִים אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מִשָּׁם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְאֶת־כַּפְתֹּרִים׃
1:12.english: the Pathrusim and the Casluhim (the Philistines came from there), and the Caphtorim.

1:13.english: Canaan fathered Sidon his firstborn and Heth,

1:14.english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

1:15.english: the Hivite, the Arkite, and the Sinite,

1:16.english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

1:18.hebrew: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד יָלַד אֶת־שָׁלַח וְשֶׁלַח יָלַד אֶת־עֵבֶר׃
1:18.english: Arpachshad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.

1:19.hebrew: וּלְעֵבֶר יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים שֵׁם הָאֶחָד פֶּלֶג כִּי בְיָמָיו נִפְלְגָה הָאָרֶץ וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יָקְטָן׃
1:19.english: Two sons were born to Eber. One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided. His brother was named Joktan.
1:19.editorial_note: Peleg echoes the Hebrew verb for division used in this verse.

1:20.hebrew: וְיָקְטָן יָלַד אֶת־אַלְמוֹדָד וְאֶת־שָׁלֶף וְאֶת־חֲצַרְמָוֶת וְאֶת־יָרַח׃
1:20.english: Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

1:22.editorial_note: Chronicles reads Ebal where Genesis 10:28 has Obal.

1:23.hebrew: וְאֶת־אוֹפִיר וְאֶת־חֲוִילָה וְאֶת־יוֹבָב כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יָקְטָן׃
1:23.english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were Joktan’s sons.

16:24.english: Tell of His glory among the nations, and of His wonders among all the peoples.

scope: Additional readings keyed by Masoretic reference, separate from the Parallel Reader’s aligned rows. Entries with staging links document the earlier staging capture. New editorial readings were prepared in the GitHub archive.
